create_BasePredictor: create a BasePredictor instance with a checkpoint path, device, and dtype for model inference
run_BasePredictor_to: run BasePredictor.to to move the loaded model to a different device or dtype
build_BasePredictor_get_batch_size: build a call to BasePredictor.get_batch_size to retrieve the appropriate batch size for the current device
test_BasePredictor_pad_to_batch_size: test BasePredictor.pad_to_batch_size to pad a tensor up to a target batch size with zeros
review_BasePredictor_disable_tqdm: review BasePredictor.disable_tqdm property to toggle tqdm progress bar output on or off
